name: Sakamoto Castle
type: Japanese castle; water castle; destroyed building or structure
text: Sakamoto Castle (坂本城, Sakamoto-jō) was a lakeside castle in the Sengoku period, located in Ōtsu, Shiga Prefecture, Japan. Akechi Mitsuhide was the commander of the castle.

depictions.name: Sakamoto Castle
depictions.text: Sakamoto Castle (坂本城) was a Japanese castle in the town of Sakamoto in Ōmi.
